motivation: Readout-11 has near-zero training loss but over 1100 uncertainty field errors across original development languages. Expand training-only wording and include existing trajectory TRAIN prefixes; do not fit on regression labels.
protected_data: Exact normalized prefix screening against recorded original development and v10 development/calibration/challenge/regression prefixes, including memory views. This is not proof of family independence.
selection: 12 epochs, same loss, seed, optimizer and original development-only lexicographic selection as readout-11. Start from released v9; retain epoch-zero candidates. No regression/calibration fit or threshold selection.
qualification: Exposed diagnostic comparison only; a positive result still requires fresh calibration and independent final evaluation.
